messages:
ana_docs: I opened a short PR to add a section about recording rules & dashboard continuity for quota/rate panels. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4340 — wanted to surface the recommended Prometheus/Grafana approach for customers.
kevin_devex: can you paste the PromQL and a tiny example of the recording rule here? helps reviewers who don't run queries locally.
sam_eng: quick infra note: we'll emit both metric names for a short window but don't promise long-term. docs should recommend recording rules rather than rewriting dozens of saved panels.
jess_research: also suggest including a tiny Grafana transform example (rename field or use alias) so analytics folks can see the UI approach.
nana_docs: pasted snippet below. kept it intentionally compact.

```yaml
# Prometheus recording rule (example)
- record: redwood:rate_limit:alias
  expr: redwood_rate_limit OR redwood\.rate\.limit
  labels:
    origin: "compat"
```

PromQL example to use in panels:
```promql
avg_over_time(redwood:rate_limit:alias{project="proj_42"}[1h])
```

Grafana transform tip (JSON model example):
```json
{"transform": [{"id": "renameFields", "options": {"mappings": [{"from": "redwood_rate_limit", "to": "rate_limit"}]}}]}
```

Checklist I added to the PR under "Migration guidance":
- Review saved dashboards for panels querying the old metric name.\n- Add a recording rule like above to surface historical + new metric under one label.\n- Replace panel queries with the recording rule reference (or add a fallback OR expression).\n- Use Grafana transforms/aliases where panels are based on table output.\n- Communicate the change in the changelog and call out a 30-day window for the overlap.

kevin_devex: LGTM. tiny wording nit: change "30-day window" to "~30-day overlap (confirm infra)" so we don't assert final timing.
sam_eng: confirmed on infra thread: we'll keep dual emission for at least 21 days, likely 30. I'll add a comment on the PR to confirm once infra has the rollout schedule.
jess_research: can we include a short snippet showing how to keep dashboard alerting stable? e.g., use the recording rule in alert exprs and add a note about alert threshold drift.
nana_docs: added an alert snippet and a one-liner: "If alerts reference absolute token rates, verify thresholds after switching to alias due to label normalization."
ci-bot: docs build success for PR 4340 (lint: 0 warnings).
doc-bot: metadata tag `rate-limits` added; TOC updated.
kevin_devex: good work. I'll approve after infra confirms exact overlap duration and we have that small Grafana UI example (screenshot or JSON) in the PR. :thumbsup:
